before: - `--project` is any checkout of the repository; `--revision` is the branch, tag or commit under verification. The [instrument](#instrument "○") follows `--` and runs at the checkout's top level.
after: - The instrument follows `--` and runs at the checkout’s top level.

before: - `--epics`, `--tasks`, `--prs` and `--links` receive the related records and complete [link snapshot](#issue-link-snapshot "○"). `--agent-reviews` supplies the published review records fetched from the open epic [pull requests](#pull-request-records "○"); absent evidence holds those epics In Progress.
after: - Missing published agent-review evidence holds the epic In Progress.

before: - `--board`, `--fields` and `--items` identify the current board state.
- `--out` receives the call files; `--assignee` is the supplied [login](#assignee-login "○").
- `--others` supplies each resolved dependency issue.
- `--items` is the board's items with Status.
- `--prs` is the [pull requests](#pull-request-records "○") that name an initiative or a hot-fix.
- `--links` is the [issue-link snapshot](#issue-link-snapshot "○") of those pull requests, where the hot-fix each one delivers is read.
- `--board` is the [board identity](#board-identity "○").
- `--fields` is the board's fields.
- `--out` is the directory the calls are written to.
- `--assignee` is the [login](#assignee-login "○") assigned to work from Ready.
- `--others` is an issue file for an issue the rows depend on that is not on the board. Repeatable.
- `--unplanned` supplies each [Unplanned Initiative](#unplanned-initiatives "○"). Repeatable.
- `--project` is any [checkout of the project](#project-checkout "○"). `--revision` is the evaluated [revision](#revision "○") [Branches](#branches) names for the run.
after: - Select the evaluated revision according to [Branches](#branches).

before: - `--items`, `--prs` and `--links` receive the supplied snapshots. A row's own links, which say whether its work is under way, are read from the epic body.
after: - Read each row’s own links from the epic body to determine whether its work is under way.

before: - `--project` is the [checkout](#project-checkout "○") and `--revision` the evaluated [revision](#revision "○"); `--bases` receives [Epic-Base Names](#epic-base-names "○").
- `--project` is also where producer outputs are read, against the remote epic bases and long-lived branches it holds, so fetch them before the run.
after: - Fetch the project checkout’s remote epic bases and long-lived branches before reading producer outputs against them.

before: - `--engineering` is the [engineering worktree](#engineering-worktree "○"), where each free row's work-item file is read.
after: - Read each free row’s work-item file from the supplied engineering worktree.

before: - `--others` supplies each resolved off-board issue; `--date` selects another [record date](#record-date "○").
- `--lane <id>` supplies the requested bare decimal index. Omit it when the run names no lane. The offered units meet [Admission](lane.md#admission).
after: - Omit `--lane` when the run names no lane. Offered units meet [Admission](lane.md#admission).

before: - `--dispatch-plan '<dispatch-export-file>'` writes the [dispatch export](#dispatch-export "●").

- `--project` is a checkout of the project and each `--revision` one of the epic's bases, such as `origin/i07/e00/main`. The long-lived branch names are the ones `config/branches` states at those commits, and each `source` line names a path, commit and repository.
after: - Read long-lived branch names from `config/branches` at each supplied epic-base revision, such as `origin/i07/e00/main`; each `source` line names its path, commit and repository.

before: - `--link` names each task id and the pull request number it links. An id repeats once for each pull request, one per long-lived branch its unit changes. The row keeps the deliveries it links in place and gains each named one it lacks, so a repeated run leaves it unchanged. `--tasks` is the task issues. `--links` is the [pull requests](#pull-request-records "○")' Development-linked issues. `--fix` is the body written with the Done ticks.
after: - Repeat a task id in `--link` once per pull request, one per long-lived branch its unit changes. Retain its existing deliveries and add only those missing, so repeated execution is idempotent.

before: - `--items` is the board's items with Status.
- `--records` is the URL of the planning records folder, needed when no row id in the epic links a record.
after: - Supply the planning-records base URL when no epic row links a record.

before: - `--engineering` is the checkout holding the planning records. A row whose folder there holds no such file, or whose README does not link it, is refused.
after: - Refuse a row when its planning folder contains no matching work-item file or its README does not link that file.

before: - `--base-ref` is the pull request's base, so the surface is the change rather than the branch's whole history.
after: - Compare against the pull request’s base to isolate its change from the branch’s full history.

before: - `--links` is the supplied complete pull-request [issue-link snapshot](#issue-link-snapshot "○"); it identifies the issue each pull request delivers.
- `--since` supplies the window start in [Report Selection](#report-selection "○"), selecting the [window](#scope).
after: - Select the reporting [window](#scope) from the supplied [Report Selection](#report-selection "○").

before: - `--initiative` selects the initiative filter in [Report Selection](#report-selection "○"). **Examples:** `I08`, `owner/repo:I08`.
after: - An initiative filter can be `I08` or `owner/repo:I08`.

before: - `--initiatives` gives supplied off-board [initiative records](#initiative-records "○"), each as a separate file argument.
after: - Pass each supplied off-board [initiative record](#initiative-records "○") as a separate argument after `--initiatives`.

before: - `--summary` gives the paragraph for management.
